charge_port.notes: Rivian: every R2 has a NACS port.

supercharger_access.notes: Rivian: every R2 has a NACS port with access to over 21,000 Tesla Superchargers.

adapters_included.notes: Native NACS port. Combo CCS1 DC adapter $200 outside CA, CO, DC, DE, MA, MD, NJ, NM, NY, OR, RI, VT, WA, where a discount equal to its price applies when registering a new R2 (effectively free there). One forum report of "Included" in a configurator is unverified.

wheels.notes: 2027 R2 Performance AWD is listed in 21 inch and 20 inch all-terrain; which is standard is not stated. Standard inferred.

heat_pump.notes: Rivian told Electrek "Launch Edition R2s will have a heat pump", but Electrek also reports the EPA-tested R2 had a conventional AC system and no heat pump. That the Launch Edition is this Performance AWD trim is unconfirmed.
